name: Chang Hwa Commercial Bank, Ltd.
summary: Chang Hwa Commercial Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides commercial banking products and services in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers deposit products, including checking, demand, time, omnibus, and savings deposits, as well as foreign services, including currency deposit, negotiable certificates of deposit; remittances; and credit and debit cards. It also provides insurance products and syndicated loans, as well as short-term, mid-term, and long-term loans.
